examples.text: Another lawyer and well-known Shakespearian, Richard Grant White, says: "No dramatist of the time, not even [Francis] Beaumont, who was the younger son of a judge of the Common Pleas, and who after studying in the Inns of Court abandoned law for the drama, used legal phrases with Shakespeare's readiness and exactness.[…]"

examples.text: L’épigraphe choisie pour le premier chapitre du Précis de décomposition [d’Emil Cioran] est illustratrice à cet égard : « I’ll join with black despair against my soul, / And to myself become an enemy. » (Richard III, 581).
